text: Hey Amir - if the foreigner has held a licence for less than 5 years, they will most likely be asked to take a driving test to complete the conversion. (She will be able to drive for one year in Israel on her foreign licence, and will then have to do the conversion).  However, it's unlikely she will have to do the whole process (e.g. the theory test and the driving lessons) - it should just be a test
